cuerpo.score_nota: Weighted score: high −12, medium −6, low −2 from 100. It measures only what is automatable (≈1/3 of WCAG): use it to track trends between releases, not as conformance.

hallazgos.hallazgo: 1 groups of duplicated landmarks (<nav>, <header>…) without a distinguishing aria-label: header ×2.
hallazgos.remediacion: Name each repeated landmark (aria-label="Main menu", aria-label="Footer menu"): otherwise landmark navigation is a lottery.

cuerpo.limites: Automation ≈ one third of WCAG: this is an express filter, not a substitute for manual review (keyboard, screen reader, real contrast, audit rhyme).

cuerpo.score_nota: Weighted score: high −12, medium −6, low −2 from 100. It measures only what is automatable (≈1/3 of WCAG): use it to track trends between releases, not as conformance.

hallazgos.hallazgo: 1 text areas with insufficient contrast: rgb(29,112,184) vs rgb(210,226,241) = 3.91:1 ×1. (computed fg/background, with alpha compositing).
hallazgos.remediacion: Raise contrast to ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for large text). The effective background already includes overlays and translucency; with a background image, check that area manually.
ejemplos: rgb(29,112,184) over rgb(210,226,241) → 3.91:1 (e.g. div > div > div > button)

hallazgos.hallazgo: 5 controls with a touch area smaller than 24×24 px (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8): div#global-cookie-message > div > div > a (107×19), div > div > h3 > a (81×23), div > div > h3 > a (161×23), div > div > h3 > a (183×23).
hallazgos.remediacion: Give controls at least 24×24 CSS px (44×44 is better) via padding or min-width/min-height. Exceptions: equivalent inline links and sufficient surrounding spacing.

hallazgos.hallazgo: 6 texts clipped when the 1.4.12 spacing overrides apply (line-height 1.5, letter 0.12em): review.
hallazgos.remediacion: Content must survive text-spacing overrides without clipping: replace fixed heights with min-height (1.4.12).

hallazgos.hallazgo: DOM order differs from visual order in 2 text blocks: review with keyboard (1.3.2).
hallazgos.remediacion: Programmatic reading order must match visual order: check flex order, grid placement and position absolute (1.3.2).

cuerpo.limites: Rendered audit: honest heuristics, no substitute for a screen reader or manual review. Contrast computed over computed backgrounds; cases with background images are reported as "review". 2.5.8 allows exceptions (equivalent inline, spacing) approximated here.
